plan.title: Material PR to Reverse Auction PO

steps.note: Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the required event title while allowing the runner to generate a unique title.
Commit the required 30-minute bidding duration.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors for the two vendor bids.
Publish the configured auction.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Have the first invited vendor submit a quote of 100 through the vendor portal.
Verify the first vendor's bid was submitted.
Have the second invited vendor submit a quote of 90 through the vendor portal.
Verify the second vendor's bid was submitted.
Wait for the bidding window to end before comparing and awarding bids.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding closes.
Verify that the lower bid ranks first, representing Vendor B's rank-1 outcome without inventing vendor names.
Award the complete lot to the lowest bidder.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved for PR to PO test

steps.note: Approve the pending proposal with the required remark when the current buyer is the configured approver.
Complete PO creation from the awarded proposal.
Verify that one PO carries exactly the awarded PR line.
Return to the events list to verify the event is represented in History.
Open the History tab after the completed award flow.
Assert that this plan's event appears in event History.
